scope: Read-only domain/API/migration/schema source inspection; no live database, private state, Native, provider, Source or Main changes. Root-reported current state is not independently attested here.

finding.claim: controlTask CANCEL/PAUSE on an active nonterminal Run writes a control request, changes Run to CANCEL_REQUESTED except RECONCILING/LOST, and leaves Task BLOCKED. It cannot terminalize the Run or Task. Client cancellation ACK likewise waits for terminal Run plus stopped/empty/settled proof.

cancelRun only records intent; acknowledgeRunCancellation requires trusted runtimeObservation CANCELLED and matching immutable runtimeReceipt; reportRun requires trusted terminal observation; reconcileRun requires observation and receipt but stays RECONCILING. The expired lease excludes ordinary report/ack, while cancel/reconcile skip lease without producing terminal proof.

RecoverExpiredRuns moves expired nonterminal Run to RECONCILING and keeps ownership. Coordinator Recover without locator/journal marks dispatch UNKNOWN; recoverTerminal needs a real bridge journal/observation and exact epoch, active Task and reconciled effects. PREPARED with no worker has no native terminal observation.

Coordinator commits STARTED with worker and locator before StartBridge. A PREPARED row with empty worker/locator is evidence no coordinator native launch was committed, subject to current-row integrity and absence of alternate effects; it is not evidence that external provider calls total zero.

Admission requires DRAFT qualification Task, and immutable runtime_qualification_runs is keyed by project/task. Existing Task cannot be readmitted; nonterminal Run occupies concurrency, and all historical Runs count toward max_attempts. Qualification Task is intentionally skipped by generic runtimeTaskTerminal.

Run FAILED and Task FAILED already exist in entity schema, but Run disallows extra fields. Dispatch CHECK has no ABANDONED state. Qualification acceptance requires the exact run SETTLED, so an abandoned Run cannot be misread as a successful qualification.

effectsReconciled only rejects unresolved recorded effects; zero matching rows do not attest absence of external provider calls. releaseQualificationReservation would write zero-amount RELEASE and therefore needs independent cost/side-effect proof before use.

legal_continuation.now: Preserve the old Run/Task/dispatch/once/clock/failure history. Do not launch a second model trial, fabricate a worker observation, direct-edit SQL, or claim this trial recovered. If an authenticated durable journal is later found, use existing Recover path under its exact proof checks. Otherwise no current API closes this tuple.
legal_continuation.custom_gap: An independently reviewed trusted local Service operation for exact pre-dispatch abandonment is required. Root must first establish provider/cost accounting and no alternate side effects. UNKNOWN provider total blocks financial closure and zero-cost reservation release.
legal_continuation.after_patch: Once the old Run is lawfully terminal and accounting closed, any new Task/Run is a separately authorized trial with a new immutable lineage, current policy/attempt/concurrency checks, and independent source/binary/input reviews. Old once and clocks are never reset; the same qualification Task and marker cannot be reused.

minimal_patch_boundary_not_implemented.entrypoint: Add a local trusted Service operation scoped to the reported project/task/run/epoch/dispatch; do not make generic cancelRun or reportRun accept synthetic runtime observations.
minimal_patch_boundary_not_implemented.authority: Authenticate a current owner/root plus designated scheduler or equivalent narrowly authorized local recovery principal; bind the request to frozen project, Task, Run, runtime, qualification marker, dispatch_key and manifest_hash, and a separately reviewed evidence digest. Exact authority shape is a contract decision.
minimal_patch_boundary_not_implemented.atomic_predicates: Under the same write transaction/resource lock as dispatch launch, CAS expected Run/Task revisions and active_run_id, exact epoch, immutable qualification marker, dispatch PREPARED (or independently proven no-worker UNKNOWN), worker/locator empty, identity {}, sequence 0, observation hash empty; prove no runtime observation, native identity/journal, queue/effect, artifact, billing or provider request footprint. No blanket UNKNOWN acceptance.
minimal_patch_boundary_not_implemented.proof_and_accounting: Store an immutable, hashed abandonment proof tied to each source of no-launch/no-effect evidence and external provider accounting. Refuse zero-cost release while provider totals remain unknown. Reconcile actual charges before terminalization if any exist.
minimal_patch_boundary_not_implemented.write_set: In one transaction seal abandonment proof, consume dispatch PREPARED to terminal ABANDONED with CAS, set old Run to a contractually defined terminal failure state and Task to a truthful terminal state, emit lifecycle events, settle qualified reservation only with proven amounts, retain old active_run_id, qualification marker and every attempt/failure record. No invented worker journal or runtimeObservation.
minimal_patch_boundary_not_implemented.recovery_race: Update Coordinator Recover/markUnknown to recognize sealed ABANDONED and never rewrite it UNKNOWN; dispatchGate and RunAdmitted must be fenced by the same transaction and terminal Run/dispatch state. A concurrent STARTED worker invalidates abandonment and falls back to journal recovery.
minimal_patch_boundary_not_implemented.contracts_migrations: Version a narrow pre-dispatch abandonment proof/operation contract outside the frozen v2.0 snapshot. Add a new SQLite migration to extend runtime_dispatches state CHECK with ABANDONED while preserving immutable manifest/no-delete triggers and existing rows; add immutable proof table keyed by project/run/epoch/dispatch. Keep existing Run/Task statuses if FAILED semantics are approved, or version current entity/client contracts if new status/fields are required. No implicit migration of populated stores.
minimal_patch_boundary_not_implemented.policy_decisions: Decide whether pre-dispatch failure increments no-progress failure count and how a new qualification Task is represented; never decrease historical Run count or bypass max_attempts.
